recipes.name: pwt_panel
recipes.description: Country-year panel of core Penn World Table variables for Brazil, Germany, Spain and the United States.

steps.name: reshape_long
steps.description: Reshape the wide export (one column per year) into one row per country, variable and year.

steps.name: keep_core_variables
steps.description: Keep eight core variables: three measures of GDP, population, employment, hours worked, human capital and TFP.

steps.name: pivot_to_panel
steps.description: Spread the variables into columns, giving one row per country and year.

recipes.name: gdp_per_capita
recipes.description: GDP per capita, its annual growth, and its level relative to the United States.

steps.name: derive_measures
steps.description: Compute GDP per capita (rgdpe / pop, in 2021 US$), its annual growth in percent (from rgdpna / pop, the series PWT recommends for growth over time), and its level relative to the United States in the same year.
